data.description: Extended and Elevated | G+2 Palm Villa | 19% Bigger Plot | Smart Living | Roof Lounge | Infinity Pool and Jacuzzi
data.display_address: Frond E, Garden Homes, Palm Jumeirah, Dubai
data.long_description:
This fully upgraded G+2 villa on Palm Jumeirah’s Frond E offers a rare combination of scale, design, and precision. Sitting on a 7,996 sq.ft plot, 19% larger than a standard Garden Villa with 7345.18 sq.ft built-up area spread across three floors, including a 1,108 sqft private roof floor with a lounge, pantry, and bathroom.

The villa was originally designed with five bedrooms but has been cleverly optimized to allow conversion to seven bedrooms, each with ensuite bathrooms. The layout balances functionality with refinement.

Outdoor features include a custom-built infinity pool, an integrated Jacuzzi, and a 3-meter extension to the landscaped area. Internally, the design showcases VADA stone feature walls, Corian Dupont surfaces, luxury marble flooring, and custom joinery.

The villa is fully equipped with a smart home system, allowing centralized control of lighting, curtains, air conditioning, and security. It also includes indoor and outdoor sound system integration for seamless entertainment.

All MEP works have been upgraded. A Swift Pro elevator connects all floors. Energy efficiency is enhanced through solar power panels, while the Cortizo aluminum glazing system provides thermal insulation and sleek aesthetics.

This property reflects the collaboration of premium brands including:
Bang & Olufsen, VADA Stone, Corian Dupont, Miele, Siemens, Cortizo, and Swift Pro.

Key Features
• Plot Size: 7,996 sq.ft (Regular: 6,700 sq.ft)
• BUA: 7345.18 sq.ft (Regular: 5,000 sq.ft)
• Floors: G+2
• 1,108 sqft Roof lounge and pantry
• Bedrooms: 5 ensuite + space for 2 more
• Kitchens: Show kitchen + dirty kitchen
• Staff Rooms: Service staff accommodation included
• Pool: Infinity pool with Jacuzzi
• Elevator: Swift Pro lift installed
• Smart Home: Full integration (lighting, A/C, curtains, security)
• Sound: Indoor/outdoor sound system (Bang & Olufsen)
• Glazing: Cortizo aluminum system
• Finishes: VADA stone walls, Corian Dupont countertops & vanities, luxury marble floors
• Energy: Solar power system installed
• Facade: Fully reworked architectural envelope
• Additional Features: Internal desert dry garden, custom joinery throughout

Company name: Provident Real Estate
RERA ORN: 1933
